nodes.label: Gadget & Gear BD Platform
nodes.rationale: Enterprise e-commerce + ERP platform for electronics retail; replaces fragmented third-party tools with an all-in-one self-hosted ecosystem.

nodes.label: MongoDB
nodes.rationale: Scalable NoSQL with 25-27+ collections; avoids third-party SaaS lock-in.

nodes.label: Next.js 15 (App Router)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for SSR, static optimization, fast page loads and SEO superiority.

nodes.label: Next.js Serverless Route Handlers (REST APIs)
nodes.rationale: 20+ specialized API modules powering storefront and administration.

nodes.label: TypeScript 5.8
nodes.rationale: Type safety, maintainability, fewer runtime bugs.

nodes.label: Zod Validation
nodes.rationale: Sanitized/validated inputs for protected API endpoints.

nodes.label: robots.txt (Allow all crawlers)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly allows Googlebot, Bingbot, Twitterbot, facebookexternalhit and all other agents full access to support SEO and social link previews.

nodes.label: Mongoose / LocalStorage Store Fallback
nodes.rationale: Data layer uses Mongoose with a LocalStorage-backed fallback store when the database is unavailable.

nodes.label: GG Lightning SVG Favicon
nodes.description: 64x64 vector favicon: dark (#0B0F19) rounded-square container with blue-to-cyan gradient border (#2563EB -> #3B82F6 -> #06B6D4), ambient glow circle, stylized 'G' path in gradient and a white lightning-bolt accent. A different (older/alternate) design from the pixel-block G PNG mark.
nodes.rationale: SVG comments describe it as a 'Gear & Tech Motif with Stylized G' - dark tech aesthetic with glow to signal electronics/gadgets.

nodes.label: Gadget & Gear BD Brand Identity
nodes.description: Brand identity of the Gadget & Gear BD e-commerce store: royal-blue palette with gradient fades, geometric sans typography, pixel/block motif evoking digital gadgets, and '.bd' Bangladesh market reference.

nodes.label: Gadget & Gear G-Mark Icon
nodes.description: Canonical square brand mark for Gadget & Gear BD: a bold half-ring 'G' with vertical blue gradient (#155EEF-ish royal blue to pale periwinkle) and offset pixel squares (solid blue at top, bright blue and pale lavender at bottom) suggesting digital/pixel tech. White background.

nodes.label: Gadget & Gear BD Wordmark Logo
nodes.description: Horizontal full logo: the pixel-block gradient 'G' mark on the left, overlapped by the bold geometric sans-serif wordmark 'GADGET & GEAR' in royal blue, with a small rotated '.bd' suffix (Bangladesh domain) at the end.

nodes.label: Gadget & Gear G-Mark Icon (Next.js app apple-icon)
